article.title: Reasonable time a question of fact.
article.content:
63Reasonable time a question of fact.

Section 63  ·  Chapter VII  ·  page 14 of the Act
Where in this Act any reference is made to a reasonable time, the question what is a reasonable time is a question of fact.
